name: CJC-1295
effects: GHRH analogue — stimulates pituitary GH release (DAC version: half-life ~6–8 days via maleimide-albumin binding)
Increases IGF-1 levels; promotes muscle hypertrophy and fat metabolism
Often stacked with ipamorelin (GHRP) for synergistic GH pulse amplification
Common dosing: 250–500 µg once or twice weekly (DAC form); or 100–300 µg 3x/week (no-DAC/Mod-GRF 1-29)
Water retention, joint pain at high doses; possible insulin resistance with chronic use
Not FDA approved; banned by WADA
